lina (finance): Heads up — Visa dispute received for ACCT-9832. Chargeback code CB-4854. Provisional chargeback amount $18,742. Need an evidence package by EOD. Please stop auto-collection for invoice INV-2026-0042 and flag account hold.

alex (support): Customer (cust_0912) claims unauthorized access — says they didn't sign up. Ticket #SUP-1764: https://support.redwood.com/ticket/SUP-1764. Customer insists on immediate refund.

samir (fraud): BIN 400555 -> prepaid pattern, risk score 78/100. Multiple IPs from unfamiliar geo, velocity spike yesterday ~03:14 UTC. Recommend hold + full evidence package. :eyes:

maya (billing): On it. Pausing cron dunning for INV-2026-0042 now. Marking invoice as 'under review' so collections don't retry.

payments-bot: transaction_id: txn_3K9fQpL4, processor: Stripe, capture_time: 2026-03-20T22:10:45Z, card_last4: 4142, dispute_submitted: 2026-03-22T15:02:11Z

alex (support): Attaching consent/onboarding logs and session traces. Files: onboarding_log_176000.pdf, session_trace.txt (uploaded to internal ticket).

eng-ops: I can pull request-level logs and model request payloads for 2026-03-20 21:30–22:30 UTC. Will export request payloads, KV cache traces, and the node affinity logs. What evidence format do you want?

samir (fraud): Evidence checklist (recommended): 1) proof of service (usage logs + token counts), 2) onboarding consent screenshots, 3) IP addresses + user agents, 4) billing descriptor, 5) fraud analysis writeup. Bundle as PDF. Also include refund policy link.

lina (finance): @priya (legal) — confirm any C2 hold requirement and whether we should pre-approve a provisional refund if the chargeback finalizes.

priya (legal): Confirmed — preserve all logs and DO NOT delete any customer data. If dispute escalates, provisional refunds require exec approval. Evidence must be submitted with chain-of-custody notes. Send package to legal@redwood.com.

maya (billing): Evidence package compiled: evidence_INV-2026-0042.zip (8 files). Uploading to secure S3: s3://redwood-evidence/INV-2026-0042/evidence_INV-2026-0042.zip. Will also prepare Stripe-friendly PDF bundle <=8MB.

samir (fraud): Also flag ACCT-9832 to throttle automated calls for 12h and block new API key creation while investigation is open.

lina (finance): Done — hold set, billing paused, account throttled. Who wants to draft the dispute rebuttal? Need short timeline, logs, and receipts.

alex (support): I can draft the customer timeline and consent screenshots. Samir can add the fraud analysis, Priya will add legal language.

priya (legal): I'll review and add required clauses. Targeting submission by 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC to meet bank deadlines. :lock:

payments-bot: Stripe dispute deadline: 2026-03-23T05:02:11Z. Evidence max size 8MB if uploaded via dashboard. For larger bundles use secure S3 + link in notes.

lina (finance): Thanks — tagging #incidents as well in case this is part of a coordinated ring. Post final bundle link here when submitted.

alex (support): Submitted evidence bundle via Stripe: https://dashboard.stripe.com/disputes/DP-87123/evidence — submission complete.

samir (fraud): Cross-account scan: three other accounts show same BIN + velocity pattern. I'll open a follow-up thread with eng-sre to block at edge.

maya (billing): Will monitor payments pipeline and hold until we have clear resolution.

lina (finance): Closing loop: if dispute reverses we'll reconcile and reverse any provisional credits. Keep me posted on updates. :white_check_mark:
